prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Keir Starmer was appointed prime minister on July 5, 2024, after Labour won the general election. He was the first Labour leader to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005.
